changes.newText: The Data page lists the folders of the project selected with the project selector in the top bar: your personal project shows the User folders you own, and any other project shows its own folders and the folders shared with it.
changes.newHtml: The Data page lists the folders of the project selected with the project selector in the top bar: your personal project shows the User folders you own, and any other project shows its own folders and the folders shared with it.

changes.oldText: Auto Mount: Folders automatically mounted when a session is created. If selected, the folder name must start with a dot ('.').
changes.newText: Auto Mount: Folders automatically mounted when a session is created. If selected, the folder name must start with a dot ('.'). This mode is offered only in your personal project.

changes.oldText: Folders created from the Data page are always User folders. Project folders are created by administrators from the admin Data pages.
changes.oldHtml: Folders created from the Data page are always User folders. Project folders are created by administrators from the admin Data pages.

changes.newText: A folder created from the Data page belongs to the currently selected project, so the project's other members can see it. To create a folder for yourself only, select My Project from the project selector in the header first.
